summary: This joint resolution nullifies the Bureau of Land Management's April 2022 Record of Decision on the National Petroleum Reserve in Alaska by invoking the Congressional Review Act to declare the rule has no force or effect.

scores.thoughts: This bill nullifies a rule that closed nearly half of a petroleum reserve to oil and gas leasing to protect wildlife and subsistence. By reverting to an older plan, it removes environmental protections and opens more land to resource extraction, making environmental regulation less stringent.
